g.text: How a press reaches the camera

text.style: font-size: 11.88px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: One button in your hand, a camera somewhere far away. The press travels by LoRa (a long range radio that gets through walls and

text.style: font-size: 11.88px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: trees) to a unit sitting with the camera, which presses the shutter over Bluetooth. No wires to the camera, no phone, no app.

g.text: straight = Bluetooth, or your thumb and eyes

font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: A tap takes a photo. A hold is a half-press: it keeps

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066
font-size: 10.08px; font-family: 'Avenir Next Demi Bold'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0e0f11

g.text: The handheld sends a command by LoRa

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: A 25 byte radio message, signed with a key the two

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: units agreed when they were paired, so only your

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066
font-size: 10.08px; font-family: 'Avenir Next Demi Bold'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0e0f11

g.text: The camera unit presses the shutter

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: It uses the camera's own Bluetooth remote release:

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066
font-size: 10.08px; font-family: 'Avenir Next Demi Bold'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0e0f11
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: It confirms each Bluetooth command as it lands: focus,

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066
font-size: 10.08px; font-family: 'Avenir Next Demi Bold'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0e0f11

g.text: The camera unit answers by LoRa

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: A quick Ack as soon as the command arrives, then a

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: Result once the press is done.

text.style: font-size: 10.08px; font-family: 'Avenir Next Demi Bold'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0e0f11
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: It shows for 4 seconds, then the screen goes back to

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066
font-size: 8.28px; font-family: 'DIN Alternate'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ff6410

g.text: THE RADIO LINK LOOKS AFTER ITSELF

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23272b

g.text: It picks its own speed (the screen shows FAST or SLOW), and it keeps inside the airtime rules

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23272b

g.text: for the region you set. Every command is signed.

text.style: font-size: 8.28px; font-family: 'DIN Alternate'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ff6410

g.text: PRESSED MEANS THE CAMERA TOOK THE PRESS

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23272b

g.text: The camera answers every command it is sent, and the tick on your screen is that answer, carried

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23272b

g.text: all the way back to your hand.
